title: Origin Energy Limited - acquisition of Babcock & Brown Power's Uranquinty Power Station
targets: Babcock & Brown Power's Uranquinty Power Station

timeline.event: Origin Energy acquired Babcock & Brown Power's Uranquinty Power Station.
ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Origin Energy Limited announced that it has acquired the Uranquinty Power Station from Babcock and Brown Power on 4 July 2008.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant markets to be: - The wholesale supply of electricity in New South Wales, - The supply of financial (hedge) contracts to New South Wales electricity retailers, and - The retail supply of electricity to residential customers in New South Wales.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that Origin faces sufficient competitive constraints post-acquisition and that the acquisition is unlikely to cause a substantial lessening of competition in any of the relevant markets. This conclusion was informed by the following factors: - The competitive constraint posed by the three state-owned generation businesses in NSW. - The substantial market share of the major state-owned electricity retailers and the presence of a number of competing privately-owned electricity retailers in NSW. - Origin's limited presence in the generation market and current absence of interest in any generation assets in NSW.
